name: Antalya
title: Holidays in Antalya
intro: Long beaches, a Roman old town and mountains behind on Turkey's sunny Turquoise Coast. Here's what Antalya is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The long curve of Konyaaltı Beach in Antalya, with turquoise sea and mountains in the distance

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 2 hrs ahead of the UK (3 in winter)

facts.label: Entry
facts.value: No visa for up to 90 days

facts_note: Your passport needs at least 150 days left on it when you arrive. Check entry rules and the latest travel advice on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May, June, September and October are the best months, hot and sunny with a warm sea. July and August are very hot, often around 34°C, and the resorts are busy. The season runs late, and October is still warm enough for the beach. Winter is mild but rainy, and many resorts close.

things.name: Kaleiçi old town
things.blurb: Ottoman houses, boutique hotels and Hadrian's Gate inside the old walls above the harbour.

things.name: Konyaaltı and Lara beaches
things.blurb: Konyaaltı is long and pebbly with mountain views. Lara has fine sand and big resorts.

things.name: Düden Waterfalls
things.blurb: A river tumbles straight into the sea from a cliff. Boat trips go to see it from below.

things.name: Antalya Museum
things.blurb: Statues and treasures from Perge and other ancient cities nearby.

things.name: Perge and Aspendos
things.blurb: A Roman city and one of the best-preserved Roman theatres anywhere, a short drive away.

things.name: Olympos cable car
things.blurb: A cable car rises to the top of Mount Tahtalı, more than 2,300 metres above the sea.

faqs.question: Where is best to stay in Antalya?
faqs.answer: Kaleiçi suits a city and culture trip. Lara and Belek are known for all-inclusive resorts. Side and Kemer are nearby beach towns.

faqs.question: Is Antalya good value?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. All-inclusive deals can be good value, and eating out in the old town is usually cheaper than in Western Europe.

faqs.question: Is Antalya too hot in summer?
faqs.answer: July and August are very hot. Many people prefer May, June, September or October.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Antalya from the UK?
faqs.answer: About four hours from most UK airports.
